errors.evidence: The description incorrectly defines ACC as 'average co-occurrence'. The y-axis label is 'ACC (%)', which stands for Accuracy Percentage, a common metric in this context.
The x-axis represents values up to 10^3 (or 1000), not 1e10 (10 billion).
The x-axis has a logarithmic scale, not a linear one. This is evident from the equal spacing between tick labels 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3.
The tick intervals on the x-axis are not linear intervals of 10; they represent powers of 10 (10^1, 10^2, 10^3).
The black 'Base' line clearly shows an increasing trend, not a decline.
The 'Base' line increases from approximately 38% to 44%. The description states incorrect values and the wrong direction of change.
The 'MEND' line is solid, not dashed. The legend and plot show a solid line with diamond markers.
The 'MEND' line ends at a value clearly above 55%, approximately 56%.
The 'FT' line is clearly blue in the plot and legend, not teal.
The 'FT' line starts at approximately 40% and ends around 47.5%. The stated range of 48% to 58% is incorrect.
The 'IKE' line starts at approximately 42.5% and ends around 49.5%. The stated range of 40% to 45% is incorrect.
The 'MEMIT' line ends at a value between 54% and 55%, not 53%.
The 'ROME' line starts at approximately 51% and ends at approximately 66%. The stated range of 43% to 55% is completely incorrect.
The description fails to mention the different marker shapes (circles, triangles, diamonds, etc.) used to distinguish each line series, which are a key part of the legend and plot.
